hints.title: Endpoint Contribution Invariant
hints.text: The first element weights[0] and the last element weights[n - 1] are included in every valid partition.

hints.title: Cut Point Pair Sums
hints.text: Making a division between index i and i + 1 adds weights[i] + weights[i + 1] to the total partition score.

hints.title: Selecting Extremal Pair Sums
hints.text: To maximize or minimize score, select the k - 1 largest and smallest adjacent pair sums respectively, then take their difference.

hints.title: Pair Sum Extremal Selection Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting n - 1 adjacent pair sums followed by extracting k - 1 extremes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all partition cuts is combinatorial C(n-1, k-1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory stores adjacent pair sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that bag boundaries reduce to adjacent element pair sums.
